{
  "simplified": "When Tim Costello was in Year 9 he asked his teacher whether poverty was something natural and unavoidable, like the tide or the sunrise. He later decided poverty is not natural but caused by public decisions and policies. Now 69, he has spent more than 30 years working directly on Australia’s growing poverty problems. He has traveled to war zones and disaster areas, served as mayor of St Kilda, written books, and been named a national living treasure. People sometimes mix him up with his brother, former treasurer Peter Costello, and ask whether he is the politically conservative one or the religious one. Tim Costello is a well-known Baptist minister and was the CEO of World Vision for 13 years."
}
